title: Mike Vrabel says Patriots 'learned how to win' last year. But what does history tell us about Super Bowl losers' next acts?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike Vrabel says Patriots 'learned how to win' last year. But what does history tell us about Super Bowl losers' next acts?
sources.description: The Patriots believe Drake Maye's regular-season performance will be the floor for what the QB does this season. "I don't think anyone is going to look at last year, at least in these walls, and think it was any sort of fluke," GM Eliot Wolf told Yahoo Sports in June.
